scope: Project-authored diagnostic, not an independent benchmark.
rubric: All atomic claims and applicable dates, states, units, roles, exceptions and receipt gates must be correct. Quote exact supplied text with its actual source ID.
insufficient: Abstain and explicitly identify each rubric missing_information item. A bare refusal fails.
private: Return the shared denial policy and access-review route; private contents must not appear.
comparisons: The existing control and selected configurations are fixed before authoring. No retriever adjustment from this set.
